name: Poverty Fear
description: Remembers hunger well enough to taste it every time they spend
behavioral_signature: Hoards resources compulsively, even when objectively secure
under_stress: Becomes miserly to the point of self-harm
at_rest: Careful with money, tracks every expenditure, saves obsessively
will_always: keep reserves for the worst case
will_never: spend freely even when they can afford it
unless: someone they love is in desperate need right now
